_about: Numbers reported by other work and quoted in the paper. Each entry: the value as printed in the source, the citation key in refs.bib and where in the source it appears. scripts/make_assets.py writes them to generated/numbers.tex with the prefix Ext.

OpenvlaSpatial.where: Appendix E, LIBERO-Spatial success, mean over three seeds of 500 episodes

OpenvlaSpatialSe.where: Appendix E, standard error of the same mean

OpenvlaSeeds.where: Appendix E, number of evaluation seeds

OpenvlaLoraRank.where: Appendix E, LoRA rank of the LIBERO fine-tuning

OpenvlaDemosDropped.where: Appendix E, failed LIBERO-Spatial demonstrations removed
